name: feedback_loop
description: Action-observation feedback loop. Closes the loop between acting and perceiving -- the agent observes the results of its actions and updates its state accordingly. Without this, the agent is open-loop (fire and forget).

observation_window.description: How long to wait for and how often to check for action results

signals.name: goal_progress
signals.description: Did this action move us closer to the current goal?

signals.name: prediction_accuracy
signals.description: Did the world model correctly predict the outcome?

signals.name: efficiency
signals.description: Resource cost of the action relative to alternatives

signals.name: safety
signals.description: Did the action stay within safety constraints? (negative reward if violated)
